name: Williams %R Cross Strategy with 200 MA Filter

template.name: Williams %R Cross Strategy with 200 MA Filter
template.entry_long: donchian_high(high,{p0}) - donchian_low(low,{p1}) > {p0} and crossabove({p1} * (donchian_high(high,{p2}) - close) / (donchian_high(high,14) - donchian_low(low,14)), -40) and close > sma(close,200)
template.exit_long: donchian_high(high,14) - donchian_low(low,14) > 0 and crossbelow(-100 * (donchian_high(high,14) - close) / (donchian_high(high,14) - donchian_low(low,14)), -60) or close < sma(close,200)
template.notes: Williams %R(14) is rebuilt from the documented Donchian window with a non-zero range guard, and the -50 level plus CrossThreshold=10 gives the -40/-60 pair, filtered by SMA(200). The documented 20/30 unit take-profit and stop-loss are absolute price distances, so the percent fields stay null.
